name: AzukiDAO BEAN repeated airdrop claims
summary: Bean.claim sets signatureClaimed and tokenClaimed but never checks them before paying. NFT holders replay valid signed claims and repeatedly transfer BEAN from the preminted airdrop reserve to themselves, then sell it for ETH.

loss.notes: 18,118,750 BEAN stolen from the airdrop reserve across 739 repeated claims. Each actor's theft quantity is valued at their weighted average onchain BEAN-sale proceeds, excluding first authorized claims. This proportional allocation is needed because lawful and stolen fungible tokens were sold together. ETH/USD uses a historical quote 306 seconds before the final BEAN sale. NFT purchase/resale, unrelated asset swaps, gas and later recoveries are excluded.

ageReset.description: The direct Bean runtime omits both consumed-signature and consumed-NFT checks from deployment.

sources.note: Reviewed incident anchor, root cause, loss, artifact identity and complete age history. Etherscan verified contracts/Bean.sol transfers its constructor-minted reserve in claim(), and writes both consumed-claim mappings without checking them. Source-4 is the first authorized claim of Elemental #10445 at block 17593116 index 15. Source-1 repeats identical calldata at index 19 and succeeds. It precedes the seed transaction by 193 blocks. Scan target Transfer logs from deployment through block 26113676 with topic1 = the target address padded to 32 bytes. All 1099 reserve transfers match the complete Etherscan txlist: 1098 successful claim calls and one later owner withdrawal. Decode each claim's contracts, amounts and tokenIds, in block/transaction order. The first repeated NFT or signature is source-1. After allowing each NFT its first claim, 739 repeat calls steal 18118750 BEAN in two campaigns before pause at block 17593338. 0x85d231c204b82915c909a05847cca8557164c75e: 731 replay claims steal 17868750 BEAN. Sales dispose of 17937500 BEAN for 33.207023572125296212 ETH. 0x8eadc7cc0a77594e3fa999e80e1ccb7f4e1c04e0: 8 replay claims steal 250000 BEAN. Sales dispose of 281250 BEAN for 0.503946347681594907 ETH. Source-6/7 receipts record BEAN transfers to the BEAN/WETH pool 0x711867b009c28f79972fd36a0d13a24c1fbc3c99. Their callTracers show WETH withdrawal and ETH sent to each seller. Effective BEAN valuation is each actor's summed ETH proceeds divided by BEAN sold, multiplied by source-5 ETH/USD. Only excess-claim quantities are valued, excluding original authorized claims at that actor's average disposal rate. Acquisition and resale of the required NFTs, unrelated asset swaps, gas and later recovery do not enter gross BEAN loss. Source-3 is a direct CREATE deployment by the declared creator. eth_getCode hashes identically at deployment and 17593115, and source-1 prestateTracer has that same hash. The reviewed runtime has no delegatecall, code replacement or destruction path. No signature-manager or supported-NFT change precedes the replay. Pause/unpause calls gate exposure to the original missing checks without introducing the defect. Deployment therefore supplies the latest age reset.

limitations: Mixed lawful and stolen BEAN sales use proportional allocation at each actor's average realized price.
